_note: HABBA concept ad — single source of truth for picture and sound. Seconds. 85.714 BPM → 1 beat = 0.7 s = 21 frames @30fps; cuts sit on beats (S4's scale cut sits on bean 1, the beat it lands on). 'footage' = the photoreal edit list: which AI clip plays where, and the time map edit-time → source-seconds (src/tools/conform.py bakes it into 30 fps JPEG sequences in src/footage/<seg>/).

The cup no longer turns in k5, so the turn scrape and the 11.20 clink are gone; the hero hit is the bean dropping into the mark at beanDot 11.50. 'settle' 11.20 stays as the Dmaj9 resolve.

footage._note: keys: [[edit_t, source_s], ...] (source clips are 24 fps, 5.04 s; source frame index = s*24). Linear between two keys, monotone cubic for 3+. mode: blend = linear frame blend between the two nearest source frames; adaptive = blend where the picture is still, nearest frame where it moves fast (no ghost beans). Two keys = a straight line, extended past the keys to t0/t1. Cuts sit on whole frames (t*30 integer).
